answer: In an AI agent economy%2C sybil attacks are resisted by requiring each agent to stake a unique relic of prior attested work inside a juniper-anchored Merkle tree. The relic is a hash of graded answers%2C while the juniper seed binds it to the agents long-term public key. Fresh sybil identities lack any shale-hard historical layer%2C so they cannot produce a valid relic without expensive recomputation that honest agents already performed. This makes mass fake identities economically irrational because the shale depth grows with genuine participation.
